messages:
Sam: Hi team — kicking off Luminate onboarding. Need to lock owners (integration, security, data), agree success criteria, and a rough 0-30d plan. Priya, can you confirm?
Priya (Luminate): Hey Sam — I'll lead product integration. Arjun will handle data validation, Maya handles compliance questions.
Jordan: Jordan (SE) here 12. I'll spin up a sandbox project + temp API keys. Recommend we test with a 10k-row sample first.
Arjun: I can run the tests. Please send a small sample schema and a Postman collection if possible.
Li: Proposed 30d milestones: Day 0-3: auth & sandbox; Day 4-12: ingest + mapping; Day 13-20: closed-loop tests + UAT; Day 21-30: handoff, training, renewal prep. Thoughts? :spiral_calendar:
Sam: Timeline looks fine. Draft success criteria: 1) p95 inference latency <250ms in staging under typical load; 2) integration completes without >1% data loss; 3) eval pass: >=90% on core intent prompts vs baseline; 4) internal runbook & playbook available; 5) compliance checklist acknowledged by Maya.
Priya (Luminate): Good list. Add: confirmation of data retention/PII handling for renewal team.
onboard-bot: Onboarding ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-5821 12 Owners: Sam, Jordan, Priya.
Jordan: Sample curl for the sandbox (use the sandbox key):
```
curl -s -X POST https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/chat \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer SANDBOX_XXXX" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-chat-small","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize: Hello"}]}'
```
Jordan: I'll attach a small CSV and a Postman collection to the ticket by EOD.
Arjun: I'll try the curl + CSV tomorrow morning and report failures to the ticket. If I see schema mismatches I'll paste minimal diffs.
Maya: Quick compliance note: need to confirm encryption-at-rest + KMS scope; also share any data retention window. I can join a 30-min compliance sync.
Li: Risk logged: SOC2 scoping may take >2 weeks; impact = medium on renewal enablement. Tagging weekly check-ins.
Sam: Action items: 1) Jordan -> sandbox + CSV + collection (EOD tomorrow); 2) Priya -> confirm Arjun/Maya availability for 30-min sync this week; 3) Li -> add weekly risk check to tracker; 4) Sam -> runbook template to ticket. I'll send invite for compliance + data sync. :white_check_mark:
Priya (Luminate): Will confirm sync times. Thanks everyone.
Sam: Calendar invite posted: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=def456 12 Sync Thu 11am PT. See you there.
Li: Noted and moving risk to the onboarding dashboard.
Sam: Great progress. We'll reconvene after the initial tests. :rocket:
